scripts.? stage: 1) !!! `rm -r` w/o trailing slash to avoid symlink catastrophe 2) `;` to bypass no dir errors
scripts.--- TAILWIND: written so that extra arguments can be passed
scripts.build+tw: npm run tw && npm run build
scripts.start+tw: trap 'kill 0' INT; npm start & npm run tw -- --watch & wait
scripts.? start+tw: 1) `&` for parallel run 2) `tw` is last to stay alive 3) trap/wait for graceful exit
scripts.stage+tw: npm run tw && npm run stage
